name: n4_read_alarms
description: Read the station's alarm records, newest first: by default the open ones (unacknowledged or not back to normal). Each row is {timestamp, uuid, source, source_state, ack_state, alarm_class, priority, msg_text} as the station renders them (display text, e.g. '7 nov 2026 09:20:50 CST', 'Offnormal', 'Unacked'; msg_text may be a raw %lexicon(...)% pattern); columns are the station's headers. Filters, all optional and combined with and: source (a component ORD such as station:|slot:/Drivers/Net; matches it and everything below it), alarm_class (a class name such as defaultAlarmClass), source_state (normal, offnormal, fault, alert), ack_state (acked, unacked, ackPending), since and until (BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00). A source_state or ack_state filter replaces the open default; open_only false reads every record. where echoes the BQL where clause sent; truncated is true when more records match than limit; total is the matching record count (select count(*)), null with total_note when that count failed. Every filter value is checked before any request: no quotes, wildcards or BQL of the caller reach the station. Read-only: fixed queries over the alarm: ORD.

source.description: Component ORD whose alarms to read, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers/Net

source_state.description: One of normal, offnormal, fault, alert

since.description: Oldest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00 or 2026-11-15T06:00:00Z

until.description: Newest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T23:59:59.999-06:00

open_only.description: true (default) reads only open alarms (unacked or not normal) unless a state filter is given; false reads every record

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
